info.description: Same-origin JSON REST API. Required text is trimmed and must be nonempty. Unsupported JSON fields are rejected. Foreign ticket visibility returns 404. Errors use {error:{code,message,fields}}. Unsafe cross-origin requests are rejected by Go CrossOriginProtection.

post.description: claim: operator claims an unassigned open/in_progress ticket and starts work; conflicting claims return 409. reassign: operator changes active assignment, or returns ticket to the open queue with null. resolve: operator resolves an assigned in_progress ticket with a required message. confirm: only the requester can close their resolved ticket; saves a confirmation message. request_changes: only the requester can return a resolved ticket to in_progress with a required explanation, preserving assignment. reopen: operator reopens a resolved/closed ticket with a required reason; assigned tickets return to in_progress, unassigned tickets to open. Transitions and conversation messages commit together under the parent row lock. Missing/irrelevant fields return 400; role violations 403; invisible tickets 404; stale/invalid state 409. No schema migration is required.
